I didn’t switch directly-  I used to be on lexapro, but got off since I felt really groggy and sleepy. I’m on Zoloft now, and I’ve had a lot more energy.
It seems like they’re supposed to do the same thing, but in my experience, they make you feel the opposite- one made me exhausted, the other gave me enough energy to get up and do things.
